title: Lawn mower
prompt: A labelled scale teaching model of the page 39 push cylinder lawn mower rolls over a replaceable strip of model grass. Push turns the road wheel's internal gear ring, its small pinion and the cutting reel, which spins faster than the road wheel and shears the grass against the fixed blade. Stop removes the pushing input and the reel stops with the drive. Slow view slows the same mechanically coupled action so the moving and fixed blades can be followed. See-through exposes the internal ring teeth, pinion, reel shaft, spiral cutting blades, fixed blade and wheel. Do not add an engine, independent cutting motor or unsupported height-adjustment mechanism. Specimen replacement is a teaching reset.
blurb: A teaching adaptation of the page 39 push mower couples the ground wheel, internal ring and pinion to spiral blades that shear a replaceable grass specimen against a fixed blade.
